column1: #mapping_set_description: Mappings from RHEO terms to the Health Economics Ontology (HEO) concepts they relate to. HEO concepts are the general concepts of the field and RHEO terms are real-world entities and processes or information about them, so no match is exact. Rows with subject_category relation map a relation RHEO uses (its own or a reused RO or BFO relation) to a HEO property (prefix heop, the HEO ontology namespace), and say how a real-world reading of the HEO link is expressed in RHEO; the HEO links themselves are conceptual associations. HEO concepts keep the prefix heo. skos:closeMatch is used only where the HEO concept is itself an informational or method artefact (an estimate, a specification, a model component); skos:narrowMatch where the HEO concept is a narrower kind of the RHEO term; every other real-world, process or valuation row uses skos:relatedMatch. subject_category states what kind of entity the RHEO term is: real-world entity, real-world process, record, estimate, valuation, directive, model representation, relation. subject_source names the RHEO module a term belongs to (heont:rheo, heont:rheo/rni or heont:rheo/uncertainty).

A resource is something used in care; the RHEO type is the role a material entity bears when it is used.
Both are statements of the criteria that define the persons concerned; the RHEO type is the information entity that states them.
The RHEO type is a point estimate of a quantity used in an economic evaluation, the information the concept names.
The RHEO type is an estimate of a health state utility value, with its method, instrument and population.
The concept Cost explains what a cost is; the RHEO type is an estimated valuation, with its context and source, used in an evaluation.
The RHEO type is an estimate of the cost of one unit of a resource or service, the information the concept names.
The concept Resource Use explains the meaning; the RHEO type is an estimate of the quantity used per person or event.
The RHEO type is an estimate of the probability of a kind of event, the quantity the concept names.
The RHEO type is an estimate of events per unit of person-time, the quantity the concept names.
The RHEO type is an estimate of the effect of an intervention relative to a comparator, as the concept describes.
The RHEO type is the description of the uncertainty about one estimate or assumed value.
The RHEO type is the stated assumption, with its justification, that the concept explains.
The concept explains health states; the RHEO type is a description of one state as observed, valued or modelled.
The RHEO type is a document that evidence is taken from, the kind of source the concept describes.
The RHEO type is the specification of the decision an evaluation informs, as the concept describes.
The concept explains interventions; the RHEO type is the plan specification of one option compared.
The RHEO type is the model as an information entity, the artefact the concept describes.
The RHEO type is a named input slot of a model version, the input the concept describes.
The concept Resource Use explains the meaning; the RHEO type is the process in which resources are consumed or occupied.
The concept explains transitions between care settings; the RHEO type is one person's movement from one setting to another.
The RHEO type is the directive stating whose costs and outcomes are counted, as the concept describes.
Payment by Results is England's tariff-based system the directive belongs to; the RHEO type is one tariff that sets the amount paid for a kind of care process.
The concept explains case-mix; the RHEO type records the case-mix group an episode was assigned to.
The RHEO type is the stated threshold a decision maker compares results with, as the concept describes.
The concept explains the policy; the RHEO type is a rule stating the basket, adjustment and benchmark rank.
The concept explains the QALY measure; the RHEO type is the process that calculates QALYs from utility records.
The concept explains discount rates; the RHEO type is the specification of the rates and base year applied.
The concept explains health insurance; the RHEO type lists the care an insurer covers.
The concept explains absorbing states; the RHEO type states which states are absorbing in one model or scheme version.
The concept explains incremental cost; the RHEO type is the process that produces an incremental cost record.
The concept explains opportunity cost; the RHEO type records one such valuation and names the forgone alternative.
A change of health state is a health outcome as it happens.
A clinical event, such as a stroke, is a health outcome as it happens.
Death is a process boundary, the outcome that ends a life.
Health outcomes valued in quality-adjusted life years.
Health outcomes valued in disability-adjusted life years.
A record of a valuation produced by a costing process, with its perspective.
The valuation process (unit cost valuation, aggregation, adjustment, comparison or estimation) that produces cost records.
The record of resource used in a real care process.
A QALY record holds the QALYs accrued; HEO qaly is the measure.
A model state is a model component that represents a clinical or classification state description (model state represents); observed health states of persons are recorded by state observations.
The real delivery of an intervention; RHEO_0000026 intervention specification is the plan.
A transition probability is one kind of probability estimate.
A transition specification states which entries of a transition matrix are allowed.
Micro-costing is unit cost valuation at the level of individual items.
Gross costing is unit cost valuation at the level of whole care processes.
Inflation adjustment is one kind of cost adjustment.
Discounting is one kind of cost adjustment.
Top-down costing is one kind of cost estimation.
Maintenance therapy is one kind of state maintenance resource use.
The concept explains correlation; the RHEO type states the correlation between two uncertain quantities.
One named parameter of the distribution HEO calls a parameter distribution.

The HEO link is a conceptual association between two concepts; RHEO does not assert it as a fact about the world. Real-world reading: a health care process (OGMS_0000096) has as participant a patient who has the condition.

The HEO link is a conceptual association between two concepts; RHEO does not assert it as a fact about the world. Evidence reading: an estimand of the intervention's effect names the intervention as one of the options it compares; the disease is given by the population it is defined for.

The HEO link is a conceptual association between two concepts; RHEO does not assert it as a fact about the world. Evidence reading: the disease or condition treated enters through the population specification the estimate or estimand applies to.

The HEO link is a conceptual association between two concepts; RHEO does not assert it as a fact about the world. Evidence reading: a relative effect estimate of the intervention concerns the clinical events of the condition.

The HEO link is a conceptual association between two concepts; RHEO does not assert it as a fact about the world. Real-world reading: the process realizes the provider role (OMRSE_00000012) borne by the organization or person.

The HEO link is a conceptual association between two concepts; RHEO does not assert it as a fact about the world. Real-world reading: the organization or person takes part in the process it carries out.

The HEO link is a conceptual association between two concepts; RHEO does not assert it as a fact about the world. Real-world reading for decision bodies: the recommendation, tariff or rule is issued by the organization.

The HEO link is a conceptual association between two concepts; RHEO does not assert it as a fact about the world. Evidence reading: a rate, probability or relative effect estimate concerns the event type, in a population defined by the exposure.

The HEO link is a conceptual association between two concepts; RHEO does not assert it as a fact about the world. Evidence reading: the exposed population is given by the population specification the estimate applies to.
The concept Cost explains what a cost is; the RHEO type is an estimate of the cost per unit of a resource or service.
Clinical events such as progression or stroke are health outcomes; the type identifies one kind of event that estimates are about.
The concept is the practice of tracking changes to a model over time; the type is one fixed, identified version of a model.
The concept is the input a model takes; the type records which estimate or assumption supplies that input in one model version.
Running a cohort state-transition model is one kind of model run; the type is any execution of a model version.
The concept is the results a model produces; the type is one such result, tied to the run that produced it.
The concept is a set of scores across health dimensions; the type is one combination of levels on a classification system's dimensions.
A dataset is one kind of origin of evidence; the type is a collection of data from which an estimate is calculated.
The concept is the entity that finances care; the type is the role that entity bears when it pays.
The concept is the person who gives unpaid care; the type is the role that person bears.
The concept is the range of environments in which care is delivered; the type is one such setting, as a site.
The concept explains stocks and flows; the type is a real stock of resources, such as beds or vaccine doses.
The concept is the management of a supply of medical products; the type is the stock being managed.
The concept explains medicinal products as priced units; the type is the physical product itself.
The concept is care for patients admitted to hospital; the type is one admitted stay.
The concept counts encounters in an emergency department; the type is one such attendance.
The concept counts encounters without admission; the type is one such consultation.
The concept explains how well tests detect a condition; the type is the process in which a test is carried out.
The concept is the activity of supplying medication against a prescription; the type is one dispensing.
The concept explains the movement of patients through care; the type is one conveyance of a person between settings.
The concept is the cost of a defined clinical episode; the type is the episode of care itself.
The concept is the replicable part of a behaviour programme; the type is a session in which such support is delivered.
The concept is a coordinated set of behaviour change techniques; the type is one session in which such an intervention is delivered.
The concept explains social care; the type is one process in which it is provided.
The concept is the value of unpaid caregiving time; the type is the unpaid care that is valued.
The concept is the person who gives unpaid care; the type is the care that person gives.
The concept is the output of work, which ill health reduces; the type is a person's paid work itself.
The concept explains how purchasers pay providers; the type is one transfer of money from a payer to a payee.
The concept is the probability that infection passes on contact; the type is one passing of infection.
The concept is the rate at which susceptible people become infected; the type is each transmission that makes up that rate.
The concept explains health behaviours; the type is a person's own conduct that affects their health.
The concept explains HTA; the type is the decision process of an HTA body about one technology.
The concept explains health states; the type describes any state into which persons or other entities are classified.
The concept is the state a patient occupies at a time; the type records which state applied to one entity on one date.
Transition probabilities are estimated from records like this; the type records one entity's passage between two observed states.
The concept explains innovation; the type records a move into a state that an innovation opened.
Maintenance therapy is the usual evidence that a state was actively reproduced; the type is a replacement with such evidence linked.
The concept explains the ways purchasers pay providers; the type specifies one such way.
The concept explains how providers are paid; the type records one payment.
A managed entry agreement is one kind of price agreement.
A price agreement records a price, often a confidential net price.
The concept explains stocks; the type records the size of one stock or group at a time.
The concept explains flows; the type records the count moving in one flow over a period.
The concept explains the movement of patients; the type counts such movements.
Catastrophic expenditure is judged against household budgets; the type records a household's total consumption or income.
The concept is the conversion of costs between currencies; the type is the estimate of the rate used.
An exchange rate is one kind of currency conversion estimate.
A purchasing power parity factor is one kind of currency conversion estimate.
The concept is the binding decision an assessment body issues; the type is one recommendation, with its decision.
The concept is a formal ruling on funding; the type is the recommendation in which an HTA body states it.
The concept is how well a test detects a condition; the type is an estimate of it, such as a sensitivity.
The concept is the valuation of health states; the type records one person's valued state at one time.
The concept explains health utility; the type records a utility measured in one person.
The concept is the weight given to a non-fatal state; the type is an estimate of it.
The concept explains public health programmes; the type is one such programme as it is delivered.
The concept explains the health workforce; the type is one workforce of one organization or setting.
The concept explains payment that depends on outcomes; the type is one such agreement.
The concept is a group of trial participants receiving one intervention; the type specifies that group in the trial plan.
The concept is assigning participants to groups by chance; the type records one participant's allocation.
The concept is ongoing support and personal care for people with long-term needs; the type is one stay in a care home where it is given.
The concept explains care delivered at home; the type is one home care visit.
The concept explains health insurance; the type records one person's or household's membership of a scheme.
The concept is the regulatory decision to authorise a medicine; the type is the decision process.
The concept is the body that decides; the type is its decision process.
The concept is the regulatory approval to market a product; the type is the authorisation document.
The concept is the set of rules a payer uses to decide what it funds; the type is one such rule.
The concept projects future use of services; the type is one projected count produced by a model run.
The concept is time lost from work through illness; the type records one person's absence.
The concept is the composition of a provider's patients; the type is the grouping process that assigns one episode to a group.

The concept explains why small areas differ in care use; the type is one area.
The concept is the state a patient occupies; the type is the group of entities in one state at a time.

The concept is deciding which kinds of resource use to cost; the type identifies one such kind.
A healthcare resource group is one kind of care process type specification.
A diagnosis related group is one kind of care process type specification.
The concept explains resources; the type identifies one kind of resource unit, such as a bed day.

The concept explains how new practices spread; the type is the opening of a new possibility that spreading starts from.
A change in a person's health is a health outcome; the type is any change in an entity or in the states open to it.
The concept explains innovation; the type records that a state became open, for example because of a new medicine.
The concept is drawing correlated inputs together; the type specifies their joint uncertainty.
A Dirichlet distribution over transitions is one kind of joint uncertainty specification.
A probabilistic sensitivity analysis draws its inputs; the type is the identified set of draws.
The concept is one pass through the model with one set of draws; the type holds all the draws of an analysis.
The concept is the sum of all costs; the type is the process that adds cost records into a total.
